items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: I know about it, but I can't remember it.

ctx.x: Yeah, you heard about how he killed him, huh? Uh-huh.
How about, uh, you remember the killing in the 101 Ranch or in the Tuxedo down there when they killed Billy Phillips? The Jip the Blood was in it?

Well, I came along, I came along a few years later. I know about it, but I can't remember it. About the Jip the Blood and all that stuff down there. About killing the chief and all the guys. Killing the chief was in 1895.

items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You mean Billy Phillips and that Parker fella that got killed? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, what he said about the killer of the chief, way back down years ago.

ctx.x: Yeah, the Tom Anderson Cabaret. He hung around there, huh? Yeah, he used to come in there and sing all those numbers he made up. And he made up another song about Gypsy Blood, the time they had all that killing down there. He had several little songs right there.
You mean Billy Phillips and that Parker fella that got killed?
Yeah, what he said about the killer of the chief, way back down years ago.
